content_sections.heading: HAL Director (Human Resources) Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The applicant should have experience as follows: Category-I: Priority to applicants with 5 years' experience during the last 10 years in HR/IR/Personnel. Category-II: Applicants with minimum 2 years' experience in HR/IR/Personnel + 3 years as functional head of Projects/Plants having direct responsibility of 1000 workforce during the last 10 years. Category-III: The applicant should have mandatory experience of five (05) years during the last ten (10) years as functional head of Projects/Plants having direct responsibility of at least 20% of the workforce. Experience in Defence, aerospace, and heavy Engineering would be desirable. The applicant must, on the date of application and date of interview, be employed in a regular capacity in a Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE), Central Government Group 'A' Officers (including Armed Forces, All India Services, Public Sector Banks, Financial Institutions, Autonomous Bodies), State Public Sector Enterprise with annual turnover of Rs. 10,000 crore or more, or Private Sector company/Joint Venture/Federation with annual turnover of Rs. 10,000 crore or more. Internal candidates require one year of service in the eligible scale, while others require two years, as on the date of vacancy.

rows.qualification_required: The applicant should be a graduate from a recognized University/Institute. Post Graduate Diploma or Degree in Personnel Management/Human Resources Management or Masters in Business Administration (MBA)/Post Graduate Diploma/Programme in Management (PGDM/PGPM) from a recognized University/Institute is desirable. Engineering degree may be desirable.

content_sections.heading: HAL Director (Human Resources) Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age of superannuation is 60 years. On the date of occurrence of vacancy (DOV): Internal Candidates: Minimum age 45 years, with 2 years residual service as on the date of vacancy w.r.t. the date of superannuation. Other Candidates: Minimum age 45 years, with 3 years residual service as on the date of vacancy w.r.t. the date of superannuation.

Ensure the application is submitted online by 03:00 PM on 12.10.2026.

content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online only; physical copies or applications via email will be rejected. Incomplete applications and those received after the stipulated date shall be rejected. Central Government officers, Armed Forces, All India Services, and officers from Public Sector Banks/Financial Institutions/Autonomous Bodies will be considered only on immediate absorption basis. faq.question: Q1. What is HAL Director (Human Resources) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by the Public Enterprises Selection Board for the post of Director (Human Resources) at Hindustan Aeronautics Limited under advertisement number 102/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for HAL Director (Human Resources) post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application by the applicant is 12.10.2026 up to 03:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay scale for HAL Director (Human Resources)?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a pay scale of Rs. 180,000 – 340,000 (IDA).

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The applicant should be a graduate from a recognized University/Institute. A Post Graduate Diploma or Degree in Personnel Management/Human Resources Management or MBA/PGDM/PGPM is desirable, and an engineering degree may be desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HAL Director (HumanResources)?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 45 years with required residual service of 2 years for internal candidates and 3 years for others, up to the superannuation age of 60 years as on the date of vacancy.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available in HAL Director (Human Resources) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for HAL Director (Human Resources)?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the application form online only through the PESB website at http://pesb.gov.in/ and forward it through the proper channel as specified.
